user.title: Adaptive Lighting Helpers
user.description: Registers the adaptive_lighting_helpers.compute_lighting_groups, compute_curve, compute_scene_coverage, and apply_lighting services. Nothing else to configure here - add day-phase/curve sensors afterwards from this integration's own page (Add Sensor).

user.title: Add an Adaptive Lighting sensor
user.description: Adds a day-phase/curve sensor and phase-override select. Entities are prefixed with the name (e.g. "Living Room" -> sensor.living_room_adaptive_lighting) - leave it blank for bare entity IDs instead (sensor.adaptive_lighting). At most one sensor may leave the name blank.

data.name: Name (blank for bare entity IDs)
data.sticky_phase_override: Keep a manual phase override until cleared by hand (instead of self-clearing at the next phase boundary)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure sensor
reconfigure.description: Renaming isn't supported here since it would change this sensor's entity IDs - remove and re-add instead if it needs a new name.

data.sticky_phase_override: Keep a manual phase override until cleared by hand (instead of self-clearing at the next phase boundary)

error.already_configured: A sensor with this name (or another blank-named sensor) already exists
